instruction: Inspect the original and labelled image. The CPU already computes physical reading order, so do not return an order. In one pass: (1) assign every token exactly one role from MASTHEAD, HEADER, TEXT, ADVERT, OTHER, UNKNOWN; (2) list the tokens eligible for the main reading stream; (3) partition every token exactly once into semantic units. Development-only corpus conventions: MASTHEAD and OTHER are excluded; HEADER and TEXT are included; a HEADER normally shares a unit with its following TEXT when they form one item; units observed in development do not cross columns; masthead fragments share one MASTHEAD unit; unrelated notices or adverts stay separate. These are provisional conventions, so mark uncertainty rather than forcing a confident semantic interpretation. Tokens are random and opaque. Return JSON only.
leakage_control: Random visual tokens reveal no source ID, order, role or semantic unit. Validation labels and XML are outside the reader packet.
binding_control: Strict software validation binds tokens after response; no repair is permitted.
reference_warning: Distributed role/order/SSU fields are provisional labels, not independently adjudicated truth. Page 0015 is consumed after scoring.
